why: The problem was already solved before the snapshot: David Smith, Kaplan, Myers and Goodman-Strauss posted the 'hat' aperiodic monotile preprint in March 2023 (arXiv:2303.10798), with formal journal publication in Combinatorial Theory in July 2024. This is a pre-snapshot resolution the list did not reflect; a February 2025 Empa physics result on a molecular analogue is a different, related phenomenon, not this problem.
